item.title: Quiz: How much has Musk given to Republican groups since July?
item.description: Also this week: White House staffing changes, a reality star's comeback, and Elon Musk doing Elon Musk things.

item.title: Appeals court to weigh who owns presidential papers
item.description: The administration argues that papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not the American people. The case could reach the Supreme Court.

item.title: Oscar-winning actor Eva Marie Saint remembered
item.description: Saint died Oct. 6. She trained at the Actors Studio and was known for roles in On the Waterfront and Hitchcock's North by Northwest.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: A shooting at an Oregon school killed three children and a teacher, as Russia assesses Ukraine's strikes and its widening rift with the U.S.
